dashboards.name: Dark routed vs executed
dashboards.description: Where our dark flow was ROUTED against where it actually EXECUTED, by venue, for one country or the whole book. The two pies share a shape but not a denominator - the gap between them is the point, and fill_rate names it. Reads the same in real time and over a date range. Source of truth is dark_routed_executed_kmonitor.q; regenerate this file with build_dashboard.py rather than editing it.
